name: missing-peer-headers
request: GET peer project without peer headers

name: invalid-peer-key
request: GET peer project with wrong key

name: wrong-organization-header
request: GET peer project with another valid organization UUID

name: wrong-organization-body
request: PUT projection with body organization differing from header/configuration

name: source-identity-spoof
request: POST seed with source.system different from authenticated peer

name: projection-path-id-mismatch
request: PUT projection with body suiteProjectId different from path UUID

name: malformed-project-id
request: GET peer project with non-UUID suiteProjectId

name: stale-projection
request: PUT projection sourceVersion below persisted sourceVersion

name: duplicate-projection
invariant: Same localId and exactly one local project/mirror

name: duplicate-seed
invariant: Same suiteProjectId; no repeated plan overwrite

name: rebind-existing-mapping
request: POST link or peer instance to different previously linked localId

name: integration-disabled
request: Call user integration API with SUITE_ENABLED=false

name: remote-timeout
request: Synchronize registered project while one peer is unreachable
invariant: Failed peer sync status error; other peer success retained

name: unsupported-accounting-currency
request: PUT AssociaGo projection with currency USD

name: redirect-not-followed
invariant: No request to redirected host; no key forwarded

name: subcent-accounting-budget
request: PUT AssociaGo projection with plannedBudget amount 100.001
invariant: No rounding or local ledger mutation
